info.name: BuhPro MVP
info.description:
BuhPro MVP Postman collection (derived from current Gin router/handlers + DEMO.md).

Recommended run order:
1) System
2) Auth
3) Orders
4) Dev Payments (confirm order payment)
5) Responses
6) Dev Payments (confirm response payment)
7) Selection & Lifecycle
8) Reviews
9) Rating & Sanctions
10) Courses
11) Notifications
12) Chats
